method: Weighted acceptance milestone score v2; completed milestones only. Weights are declared planning choices, not measured effort or code coverage. The native-PC gate includes the optional SUPIR HD texture pack; the FPS/resolution gate includes texture/render/aspect settings. The scope includes the N64 and PlayStation demakes and their model/asset adaptation. Existing weights are preserved. No fractional credit for unfinished work.
uncertainty: Not an estimate of remaining time, difficulty or percentage of code recovered. Broad unfinished gates intentionally stay uncredited.
evidence_basis: Existing verification artifacts inspected; extraction/decoding not rerun during this audit. Full goal remains active.

main_binary_draft_inventory.limitation: Ghidra pseudocode is preliminary and is not buildable or behavior-verified source; its function index is not a complete executable code/data boundary audit.

requirements: Adapt or recreate models and other assets to fit each target platform
Build and verify a playable version for each target platform

decompilation_acceptance: Recovered buildable source for all executable game modules, with tracked code/data boundaries and function coverage
Verified original behavior; playable static recompilation alone is insufficient

hd_textures_and_display.processing: Offline preparation of an optional HD texture pack; no AI inference during gameplay
hd_textures_and_display.coverage_target: All identified game textures, with an identity/coverage manifest and quality review

settings.texture_resolution_meaning: Percentage of active original/HD texture width and height; Off disables game-texture sampling and uses vertex colours, or existing material colour if vertex colours are absent
settings.hd_toggle_meaning: Select HD versus original assets when textures are enabled; preserve this choice while texture resolution is Off
settings.render_resolution: Selectable internal dimensions independent of texture quality and output resolution; retain PC output support through 7680x4320

acceptance: Inventory every texture identity, including archives, animation, UI and language variants; preserve source hashes and lookup mapping
Pin SUPIR/model versions and batch settings; pilot representative assets before full conversion
Review art-style fidelity, accurate text, alpha/masks, tile seams, atlases, animation and mipmaps
Track missing/rejected replacements explicitly; retain original fallback without treating fallback as completed HD coverage
Verify every toggle/percentage, settings persistence, pack failure handling, resource reload and memory budget
Verify texture Off disables all game-texture sampling and preserves vertex/material colours; returning to a percentage restores the selected original/HD set
Verify internal dimensions and aspect-correct camera/culling/HUD/movie presentation independently of texture quality and simulation speed
hd_textures_and_display.platform_scope: PC first; adapt options, texture formats and budgets to Android/3DS, and separately adapted assets to N64/PlayStation demakes
